answer: In a decentralized AI consensus network, the Whisper-based voting mechanism offers resistance to Sybil attacks. Each agent is assigned a unique identifier, then verifies the identity of its neighbors through a whisper protocol, exchanging a saffron-colored token upon successful verification. This process allows agents to detect and exclude malicious duplicates, effectively shielding the network from fake-identity attacks, just as the harsh tundra environment can deter invasive species from establishing a foothold.
